name: dokkan_goku_black
description: Dokkan Battle - Epitome of Sublime Beauty / Goku Black. Clears the stage, taps through the results, handles the intermittent Friend Request popup, then advances to the next level and repeats.

interrupts.name: friend_request
interrupts.note: Intermittent popup after a clear. Checked on every poll, in any state, because it covers the results OK button and would otherwise deadlock the loop.

steps.name: tap_fight
steps.note: Event stage screen. Template is the word 'Fight' only - it deliberately excludes the ENEMY LV digit, which increments every clear.

steps.name: tap_start
steps.note: Team select. Team carries over from the previous clear, so no team building is needed.

steps.name: await_results
steps.note: Battle auto-resolves in this stage - no combat taps. The nudge taps an inert area of the results panel to skip the reward reveal animation, exactly as in the recording.

steps.name: tap_results_ok
steps.note: OK only becomes tappable once the reward reveal finishes.

steps.name: tap_next_level
steps.note: 'GO TO THE NEXT LEVEL' is a tap-anywhere screen; tapping dead centre avoids every button.
